name: TEXONO
summary: TEXONO studies low-energy reactor-antineutrino interactions with progressively lower-threshold germanium detectors and earlier scintillator targets. Its Kuo-Sheng programme measured electron scattering and searched for coherent nuclear recoils before the reactor was decommissioned.
detection_principle: Germanium ionization spectrometers and, in earlier phases, CsI scintillators measure recoil spectra. Shielding, active vetoes and reactor-on/off comparisons constrain weak and electromagnetic interactions.

results.summary: No neutrino recoil excess was observed before reactor shutdown. The continuation at Sanmen is distinct from evidence of a completed measurement there.
